セイバーがアサシンに負けるとは思えない。
だがこの状況は不吉すぎる。
相手はこの妖怪爺だ、セイバーを一人にさせるのは危険すぎる。

pages.en:
…Should I try using a Command Spell?

I cannot imagine Saber losing to Assassin.

But this situation is too ominous.

Our enemy is that monstrous old man. Leaving Saber alone is far too dangerous.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…Should I use the Command Spell…?
I don’t think Saber will lose to Assassin.
But this situation is too ominous.
We’re fighting this ancient monster. It’s too dangerous to have Saber by herself.

pages.ja: 「ほう？ 不出来な殺気を上手にたたみおったな。ふむ、なにやら考えがあるようだが」
pages.jaRuby: 「ほう？ 不出来な殺気を上手にたたみおったな。ふむ、なにやら考えがあるようだが」
pages.en: “Oh? You managed to put away that pathetic murderous intent of yours. Hm. It seems you have something in mind.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Oh? You’ve suppressed your poorly made murderous intent. Hm, it seems you have a plan.”

pages.ja:
嘲笑は、完全に俺を侮ったものだ。
俺がどんな策を巡らせようと構わない、所詮は子供騙しと見下す笑い。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
His sneer expresses complete contempt.

He does not care what plan I devise. Whatever it is, he already dismisses it as a childish trick.
pages.mirrorMoon:
He laughs, mocking me.
He is looking down on me, not caring what plan I have.

pages.en:
“——”

…Fine. Laugh as much as you like.

If the Command Spells truly answer my wish as their Master, then even if it takes every last one, I will summon Saber back here…!
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
…Fine, laugh all you want.
If the Command Spell can answer the Master’s wish, I am ready to use them all to bring Saber here…!

pages.en:
“Saber—”

Without taking my eyes from the darkness called Zouken, I focus my mind upon my left hand.

There is only one command.

Bring Saber before me at once—!
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Saber”
I concentrate on my left hand while glaring at Zouken.
I have only one command.
To summon Saber to my side!

pages.ja:
「ぬ…………！？」
気付いても遅い。
左手には熱がともり、凝縮された魔力はマスターの願い通り解放され、
僅かな痛みと共に、その色を無くしていった。
pages.jaRuby:
「ぬ…………！？」
気付いても遅い。
左手には熱がともり、凝縮された魔力はマスターの願い通り解放され、
僅かな痛みと共に、その色を無くしていった。
pages.en:
“What…………!?”

He understands too late.

Heat ignites within my left hand, and the concentrated magical energy is released in obedience to its Master’s desire.

With a slight pain, the mark begins to lose its color.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Mm……!?”
Even if he realizes what’s happening, it’s too late.
Heat lights up on my left hand, the concentrated magical energy is released as I wish, and…
…The Command Spell loses its color with a slight pain.

pages.ja:
「え
？」
失敗した、と思いたかった。
俺は令呪の使い方を知らないから、使い方を間違えたのだと思いたかった。
pages.jaRuby:
「え
？」

pages.en:
“What—?”

—I want to believe that I failed.

I do not know how to use a Command Spell. I want to believe that I merely used it incorrectly.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“What?”
I want to think it’s because I failed.
I want to think that I used it wrong because I don’t know how to use it.

pages.ja:
「……ふう。どうやら事は済んだようじゃの。脅かしおって、寿命が十年ほど縮んだぞ？」
耳障りな笑い声。
……遠くでは、断末魔のような風鳴りがしている。
pages.jaRuby:
「……ふう。どうやら事は済んだようじゃの。脅かしおって、寿命が十年ほど縮んだぞ？」
耳障りな笑い声。
……遠くでは、断末魔のような風鳴りがしている。
pages.en:
“…Whew. It appears the matter has been settled. You gave me quite a fright. You shortened my life by ten years, you know.”

His laughter scrapes against my ears.

…Far away, the wind shrieks like a death cry.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Phew. It seems it is over already. You surprised me. You shortened my life by ten years.”
He laughs.
…I hear wind in the distance, like a death cry.

令呪は血を流すように、急速に熱を失っていく。

Pain throbs through my left hand.

The back of the hand goes numb.

As though bleeding out, the Command Spells rapidly lose their heat—their color.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I feel a pain on my left hand.
My left hand is prickling.
My Command Spell loses its heat as if it’s bleeding.

pages.en:
“That’s… impossible.”

I have a bad feeling.

I have a bad feeling.

I have a bad feeling.

The pain in my left hand.

The wind that has fallen silent.

The presence before me—the ancient mage commanding the insects, smiling with a murderous intent so vivid I can see it.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Noway.”
I have a bad feeling.
I have a bad feeling.
I have a bad feeling.
The pain on my left hand.
The sound of wind has stopped.
The old magus is laughing with murderous intent that is almost visible.

pages.ja: 「いや、紛れもない現実よ。おぬしもマスターならば判ろう？ 己がサーヴァントが、この世から消滅した事実がな！」
pages.jaRuby: 「いや、紛れもない現実よ。おぬしもマスターならば判ろう？ 己がサーヴァントが、この世から消滅した事実がな！」
pages.en: “No, it is unmistakably real. You are a Master yourself—surely you understand? Your Servant has vanished from this world!”
pages.mirrorMoon: “That is the truth. You should be able to tell as a Master. That your Servant has been eliminated from this world!”

“Why are you standing there in a daze? Saber is dead. She underestimated Assassin and was defeated. Can you not comprehend even that, boy?”

“What… are you—?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Why are you shocked? Saber has died. She has been defeated by Assassin, one she took lightly as a weaker opponent. Can you not tell that simple fact?”
“What?”

pages.en:
What kind of nonsense is he speaking?

My left hand hurts.

It undeniably hurts.

But the Command Spells have not vanished.

They are fading, growing paler as though they might disappear at any moment, but they are still there.

Then Saber will come. She will appear here at any moment—!
pages.mirrorMoon:
What the hell is he talking about?
My left hand hurts.
My left hand certainly hurts.
But my Command Spell is still there.
It’s fading, but it’s still there.
ThenSaber should be coming here any second now!

“Quit… spouting—”

“Then let us finish. I may yet find a use for the Tohsaka girl, but I have no further use for you, boy. Perish alongside Saber upon my sacred ground.”

“—that bullshit, you bastard——!”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Don’t”
“Then let us end things here. There are still uses for the daughter of Tohsaka, but you are of no more use. You can die along with Saber on my holy land.”
“Talk shit, dammit!”

pages.ja:
走った。
左手の痛み、嫌な予感を振り切ろうと、ただ目の前の敵へと走った。

pages.en:
I run.

Trying to tear free of the pain in my left hand and the premonition of disaster, I charge the enemy before me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I run.
I charge at the enemy in front of me, as if to shake off the ominous thought and the pain on my left hand.
